After my study abroad experience in Australia, my hometown friend and I traveled the South Island of New Zealand together in a tiny red Suzuki Swift we named "Little Red Dumpling", after a delicious restaurant we both went to in Australia. On this map is my guide of everywhere we went and everywhere we saw! Truly an adventure of a lifetime.

## Some Quick Photo Highlights

::: {layout="[1,1,1]"}
![**Rob Roys Glacial Track**: My favorite hike we did! Absolutely stunning with a glacial view at the end.](robroy.jpg)

![**Tasman Glaciar Track**: One of the first and easiest hikes we did along a glacier. Our first stop on our road trip.](tasmanglacier.jpg)

![**Roys Peak**: Longest, hardest, most rewarding hike we did. We woke up at 2 am and began the hike at 2:30am to get to the peak for sunrise.](royspeack.jpg)
:::
